$comment: Model artifacts the extension ships. All are downloaded once by `npm run fetch:models`, pinned to an immutable commit and verified by SHA-256 — that is the only step in this project that touches the network. Neither model is committed: cf-vit is published upstream, and the SigLIP2 ONNX export is 343 MB, past GitHub's 100 MB per-file limit, so it is republished on the Hub by scripts/publish-siglip-onnx.py.

artifacts.attribution: Jeongsoo Park and Andrew Owens, University of Michigan, CVPR 2025 (arXiv:2411.04125). ONNX export by Han Yoon / Borderless.

Ateeqq/ai-vs-human-image-detector, Apache-2.0. Exported to ONNX by scripts/convert-siglip.py and republished because upstream ships safetensors only; the export changes serialization format, nothing else.
